title: Pandolfi email: senators let him carry the keys
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Pandolfi email: senators let him carry the keys, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Ron, there's even an email I have where Ron says uh these senators and congressmen, they're they're always uh asking these questions and they they don't realize that it's it's not the material, it's the access to the material and you can get in a lot of trouble and I tell the senators that and they just let me carry the keys.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron told podcast host Jesse Michels about an email he says he has from Ron Pandolfi, a man Cameron describes as a senior figure in the government's handling of UFOs. According to Cameron, Pandolfi wrote that senators and congressmen keep asking about the material, not realising the real issue is who can get access to it, that asking can get you in trouble, and that the senators simply let him carry the keys. If true, it would mean one insider quietly controls who reaches the secrets.
